pathogenesis: bacteria that cause inflammation of the gum tissue and bone tissue, which results with deep periodontal pockets || person's genes, disease or trauma
diagnostic_methods: bleeding from the gums, bone loss that displays itself on an x-ray, excessive tooth mobility, gum recession, or the existence of any exudate pus or clear fluid along or under the gumline
treatments: root planing, scaling and antibiotics || surgery to add tissue to the gum line
